agent_explanation: Seeded sensor noise (0.0152) on pole angle/rate corrupts the fixed state-feedback controller's measurements. The controller reacts to false angle errors with large cart forces (e.g., ~40N at steps 40-43), injecting work (external_work ~36) that pumps energy (E ~37.5 vs E0 ~1.45) and drives theta from -0.2 at step 30 to 0.86 at step 43. Removing noise alone stabilizes the identical plant/initial conditions.
